initial_requirements: State executive-branch agencies need a shared enterprise service for e-mail, messaging, calendars, and contacts. The service should support everyday communication and collaboration for agency users while allowing administrators to provision accounts, manage shared information, and apply organization-wide controls. The initiative is intended to meet confidentiality, privacy, security, retention, and operational needs while reducing the cost and duplication of separately supported agency systems.

turns.interviewer_utterance: What are the most important outcomes this shared enterprise e-mail and collaboration service must achieve for the state agencies—for example, in terms of user productivity, administrative efficiency, security/compliance, cost reduction, and service consolidation?
turns.interviewee_utterance:
The big outcome is that agency staff can communicate and collaborate reliably without each agency having to run its own separate system. We want users to have a consistent e-mail, calendar, and contacts experience that helps them do their day-to-day work faster and with fewer service problems.
From an administrative standpoint, the service should make account provisioning, shared management, retention, and policy enforcement much easier and more standardized. It also needs to improve security and compliance, especially around confidentiality, privacy, and record retention, while reducing duplicated systems and overall support costs across agencies.

slots.name: project_goals
slots.value: Enable agency staff to communicate and collaborate reliably through a consistent shared e-mail, calendar, and contacts service, while improving day-to-day productivity, simplifying administration, strengthening security/compliance, and reducing duplicated systems and support costs across agencies.

slots.name: stakeholder_roles
slots.value: Agency staff/users and administrators responsible for account provisioning, shared management, retention, and policy enforcement across executive-branch agencies.

slots.name: functional_needs
slots.value: Support e-mail, messaging, calendars, and contacts for everyday communication and collaboration; provide account provisioning, shared information management, retention handling, and organization-wide policy enforcement.

slots.name: business_rules
slots.value: Retention and policy enforcement must be standardized across agencies; organization-wide controls must be applicable to shared accounts and information; the service must support confidentiality, privacy, and record-retention requirements.

slots.name: data_entities
slots.value: E-mail messages, calendar events, contacts, user accounts, shared information, retained records, and policy/control settings.

slots.name: constraints
slots.value: Must meet confidentiality, privacy, security, retention, and operational requirements while serving state executive-branch agencies and reducing duplicate agency systems and support costs.

slots.name: quality_concerns
slots.value: Reliability, consistency of user experience, improved security and compliance, privacy protection, record retention compliance, and reduced service problems.

slots.name: boundary_conditions
slots.value: Applies to state executive-branch agencies; replaces or consolidates separately supported agency e-mail/collaboration systems rather than introducing a new standalone agency-specific solution.
